visual_review.method: Manual review of the two crops and source images.
visual_review.finding: No obvious crack or breakage. One crop has a faint smudge/glare patch; both are plausible clean eggs. The errors are over-rejection (false damaged), not missed damage.
visual_review.label_action: No test-set relabeling. Do not train on these test images.

recommendation.threshold: Keep 0.18. It maximizes damaged recall under the validation-only policy; raising it to remove these two false rejects creates damaged false negatives.
recommendation.next_data: Collect similar smudged/glare/shell-texture hard negatives in a future training split. Re-evaluate on a new locked test set.
recommendation.status: No retrain triggered by this audit.
